metadata.description: Starbridge HUD for Claude Code, plus the audited mods it works with. See README.md.

plugins.name: starbridge
plugins.description: Starbridge HUD: context gauge, live cost chips, Keep warm, cold-cache hold card, animated agents key, one-click Handover and End session

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Savvy Progress by JohnnyVizz (MIT, unmodified): the agents panel Starbridge's mascot key opens

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Blast Radius by Anthropic (Apache-2.0), with Windows fixes: holds risky commands and shows what they would delete

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Reflect by Bayram Annakov (MIT), with a Windows home-path fix and global saves off by default: turns your corrections into saved rules

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Filetree by Kurt Buhler (MIT, unmodified): your project's file tree beside the chat. Terminal only
